verdict.rationale: BigQuery release notes say pipelines can be created, stored and managed in Git folders. Dataform, documented as working in BigQuery, supports version control and Git-based collaboration on workflows, so versioning is covered. Review is only implied by Git collaboration, and rollback of automations is never explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit review/approval workflow for automation changes, documented rollback to prior automation versions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: You can now create, store, and manage pipelines in Git folders.
Dataform is a service for data analysts to develop, test, control versions, and schedule complex workflows for data transformation in BigQuery.
Collaborate with team members on workflow development through Git.
